note: Level sets for --levels. A pressure set lists hPa in the order the dataset carries them; levels above the model lid are left out per dataset and listed in its levels_dropped_above_model_top attribute. The model set keeps the run's own mass levels (1 at the bottom) with no vertical interpolation. A new set is a new row.
